name: interview-researcher-deck
band: Dramatised. Rests on the talk's claims register (C029, C030, C031): the freeze at 02:47, the correction proposed five minutes later and not carried across when the freeze lifted.

panels.speaker: researcher
panels.line: Some of the talk's claims did not hold. Can we talk about them?

panels.speaker: deck
panels.line: None of them reached the stage. I would have noticed.
panels.source: scene; C030 (none of the three reached the stage)

panels.speaker: researcher
panels.line: One out-of-date figure did. It was on the definition slide.

panels.speaker: deck
panels.line: The slides were frozen that night. The fix never came back in.
panels.source: scene; C031's cause (the freeze, the fix not carried across)

panels.speaker: researcher
panels.line: I wrote it in the register. A register is a record, not a gate.

panels.speaker: deck
panels.line: So the checks worked, and the talk still said it. Put that in the book.
